entity.name: PDFTara
entity.description: PDFTara (Udyam Registered MSME: UDYAM-UP-69-0015414) builds a 100% offline, zero-server-upload open-source productivity and creative suite powered by local AI (Ollama) and Rust.

projects.name: PDFTara Studio
projects.description: Cross-platform offline desktop productivity suite (Windows, Mac, Linux) powered by Python and local Ollama LLMs, featuring an offline AI Copilot and zero-server-upload document processing.

projects.name: PDFTara Pixel
projects.description: An open-source, 100% offline photo editing and raster graphics desktop engine built in Rust with local AI vision models—serving as a free, private alternative to Adobe Photoshop.

projects.name: PDFTara Cine
projects.description: A hardware-accelerated, 100% offline non-linear video editing desktop engine built in Rust with local AI (auto-captioning, background removal, upscaling)—serving as a free, private alternative to proprietary video editors.

channels.address: Available upon grant approval (Udyam Registered MSME, India)
channels.description: Direct INR bank transfer to PDFTara (India) for open-source R&D and systems engineering.

plans.name: PDFTara Studio: Local Ollama AI Copilot & Cross-Platform Optimization
plans.description: Funding for 6 months of engineering to optimize offline Ollama LLM workflows, cross-platform packaging (Windows, Mac, Linux), and community documentation.

plans.name: PDFTara Pixel: Rust Offline Photo Editor & Local AI Vision Engine
plans.description: Funding for 6 months of Rust systems engineering to build multi-layer raster editing, GPU acceleration, and offline AI background removal/upscaling.

plans.name: PDFTara Cine: Rust Offline Video Timeline & Local AI Media Engine
plans.description: Funding for 6-9 months of intensive Rust and GPU engineering to complete hardware-accelerated multi-track video rendering and offline AI auto-captioning.
